text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 504/502 rate from gateway for /v1/generate — 8.7% errors over 5m (us-west-2). Paging oncall. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/gateway-timeouts

incident-bot: Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Top upstream: egress-proxy-pool-3. Correlation sampling enabled.

sara (oncall): got it, I'm on. quick ask: customer-facing impact? any big tenants?

carla_support: support-bot report: top affected customers: cust_42 (20% failures), cust_98 (15%), cust_trial_7 (high error for last 12m). ~12k requests in last 10m to /v1/generate. Tickets opening: #SUP-1721, #SUP-1722.

matt_w: collecting kvlogs + traces now. grabbing corrids with pattern `corrid=*gateway*` and `upstream=egress-proxy-pool-3`

matt_w: running: ```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3411119876/ ./ --recursive
rgather --corrid 'corrid=~egress-proxy-pool-3' --since 10m > /tmp/3411119876-kvlogs.txt
```

matt_w: uploaded snapshot to s3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3411119876/logsnap.tar.gz (shared) :link:   

jyoti_r: quick read — seeing lots of upstream 502s with immediate retries. traces show a pattern: gateway retries to the same upstream host -> upstream returns 502 -> gateway keeps retrying which ties up worker threads. hypothesis: retry amplification + head-of-line blocking in gateway -> queue saturation -> timed out requests (504). sample trace: ```TRACE corrid=abc123 host=egress-proxy-pool-3 upstream=10.0.12.5 status=502 retry=1 latency=120ms```

kevin_s: could be upstream health flapping. can we temporarily route traffic to egress-proxy-pool-1 (healthy) as a mitigation? can we flip fallback-route for the real-time tier?

jyoti_r: yes, fallback route exists. suggested mitigation: 1) disable automatic retries at gateway for 502 from that upstream pool 2) shift weight to pool-1 3) enable circuit-breaker to prevent retries for 60s

sara (oncall): do it. matt, carla — please snapshot traces and TTL them for RCA. include corrids list.

matt_w: executed mitigation: toggled route weights -> pool-1 +30%, disabled retry policy for egress-proxy-pool-3. commands used: ```yaml
# route change snippet
route 
  match: /v1/generate
  weights: 
    egress-proxy-pool-1: 0.7
    egress-proxy-pool-3: 0.3
retry_policy: disabled_for_pool_3
```

incident-bot: MITIGATION: route weight change applied by matt_w at 3411120300. Observed error rate drop: 8.7% -> 0.9% in 4m. :white_check_mark:

carla_support: customer impact update: cust_42 saw degraded success for ~22 minutes, we will offer 2 days credit per SLA. raised CS escalation.

jyoti_r: adding timeline entries here for RCA notes: 
- 3411119876 (T0): incident-bot alerts elevated 5xx/504 for /v1/generate
- +1m: support report shows cust_42 & cust_98 high error rates
- +2m: traces show upstream 502 + gateway retries -> head-of-line blocking hypothesis
- +6m: mitigation applied (route weight shift, disable retries) -> error rate returned to baseline

kevin_s: request: please collect top 20 corrids and attach to the incident ticket. also add `upstream_conn=10.0.12.5` traces to RCA.

matt_w: uploaded corrid list to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3411119876/corrids.txt and attached to ticket. link: https://s3.console.redwood/incidents/3411119876/corrids.txt

sara (oncall): good. I'll hand off to eng-runtime for full RCA and postmortem. oncall shift: @jyoti_r take lead for timeline + hypothesis writeup, @kevin_s + @matt_w to fill kernel/log artifacts.

incident-bot: HANDOFF recorded. Pager duty: acknowledged by eng-runtime. Next steps: RCA doc -> runbook updates (consider retry backoff defaults), add canary for route weight changes, add metric alert for retry amplification.

carla_support: closing customer comms loop: emails drafted, CS will send interim note in 15m.

jyoti_r: final note: primary hypothesis = retry amplification to a flapping upstream host causing worker queue exhaustion at gateway. follow-ups: 1) confirm upstream health-check config 2) consider exponential backoff + jitter in retry policy 3) add safeguard to avoid retry loops on 5xx from specific upstream pools.

sara (oncall): thanks team. creating incident in incident-tracker #INC-2026 with RCA stub. :thumbsup:
